item.title: [github_trending] vectorize-io/hindsight
item.description: Hindsight is an open-source agent-memory project from vectorize-io, pitched as memory that learns. It ships a Python package (hindsight-api), an npm client, docs, a cookbook, a benchmark site and an arXiv paper (2512.12818), plus a hosted Hindsight Cloud. Developers who want a persistent memory layer for agents without building one from scratch can check its benchmarks first.

item.title: [producthunt] Clueso MCP
item.description: Clueso MCP, newly listed on Product Hunt, lets users create and edit videos through chat rather than a timeline editor. The listing gives only that one-line description, so supported models, export formats and pricing are still undisclosed; developers curious about conversational video workflows may want to track it.

item.title: [juejin] Cursor 转 Codex 大半个月，聊聊我的真实感受
item.description: A developer shares impressions after roughly half a month of switching from Cursor to Codex. Cursor was what first made AI coding feel striking, the author says, while Codex feels less like a coding assistant and more like a genuine super-agent, closer to the next stage of the form. Useful for anyone weighing a move from Cursor to Codex.

item.title: [infoq] Claude Opus 5.5 发布：一天内迁移 68 万行代码，单任务成本比 GPT-6 Astra 便宜 80%
item.description: Anthropic released Claude Opus 5.5, the first model in its Claude 5.5 line, shifting focus from scaling to better coding, computer use and knowledge work while cutting typical task cost about 40% versus Opus 5. The company says an early tester migrated 680,000 lines of code in under a day, and that on FrontierCode each task costs roughly 20% of GPT-6 Astra's. Sonnet 5.5 and Haiku 5.5 are coming next.

item.title: [producthunt] Superset Mobile
item.description: Superset Mobile is a new Product Hunt listing that promises to put your coding agents in your pocket, meaning you can run or keep an eye on them from a phone. The listing gives nothing beyond that tagline — which agents it supports and how it hooks into your dev environment are unstated — so it's worth a look only if you already delegate work to agents.

item.title: [v2ex] [分享创造] 做了一个面部评分站 face-rating.net：模型在浏览器本地跑，照片全程不出设备，求拍砖
item.description: face-rating.net is a face-scoring site that runs its model entirely in the browser: MediaPipe Face Mesh first locates 478 facial landmarks and aligns the crop, then a local image model scores both the photo and its mirror image and averages them into a 10-point rating. Photos and intermediate data never leave the device and no signup is needed; the author also notes the score reflects learned preferences from human rating data and publishes no averages or percentiles.

item.title: [v2ex] [程序员] 亲测用 Cloudflare Warp + 存量 Meta 账号可以直接使用 Muse
item.description: A forum user reports that Cloudflare Warp plus an existing Meta account — one upgraded from an old Facebook login — is enough to use Muse with no hacks, and says it keeps working over time, including on a phone, though he isn't sure whether the account needs anything else. The invite code ST5DVW earns tokens for both sides.

item.title: [juejin] 面试官问你：“AI 能写 80% 的代码了，公司为什么还需要你？”
item.description: A Juejin article tackles the interview question "AI can already write 80% of the code, so why does the company still need you?" It contrasts 2026 interviews with those two years ago, when candidates hand-wrote a Promise or explained React Fiber internals; today interviewers assume AI use and probe something else. Useful for developers preparing for interviews or doing the hiring, though the supplied excerpt cuts off before the full argument.

item.title: [v2ex] [游戏] [分享小小的 dle 游戏] RNGdle：每天抽一个数字，看看它藏着什么规律
item.description: RNGdle is a daily "dle" game where you draw one integer between 0 and 1,000,000 and see which math-based badges it hits — prime, palindrome, perfect square, digit patterns and more — with 233 badge rules and an EP score. The daily draw resets at UTC 00:00 and refreshing doesn't reroll it; there are also a number calculator, an Infinite mode and a Sandbox, with no signup required.

item.title: [github_trending] google/ax
item.description: AX is Google's open-source declarative orchestrator for agent workloads: you define Workspaces and Tasks in YAML, and it sandboxes them, fences their network, and schedules them across a cluster on top of Agent Substrate, with the project claiming billions of tasks per cluster. Its Kubernetes-like workflow should appeal to teams running autonomous agents in bulk, though the core concepts and protocols are still evolving and breaking changes are expected before a stable release.

item.title: [producthunt] Solid
item.description: Solid is a Product Hunt listing whose one-line description says it gives agents their own computers, accounts and budgets. Beyond that tagline, no further details are provided here — how it works and who it targets aren't spelled out.

item.title: [v2ex] [薅羊毛] [快跑 AI｜中秋抽奖活动] 每日两场，天天开奖，三天豪送 $6000 兑换码！
item.description: Kuaipao AI is an API relay platform aggregating text, image and video models plus Claude, OpenAI and Grok, pitched on low prices, pay-as-you-go billing and invoicing. For Mid-Autumn Festival (Sept 25–27, 2026) it runs six lottery draws, two a day, each with a $1,000 pool and 267 prizes — 1,602 codes worth $6,000 in total — and new users who register and reply with their id under the post get $10 in trial credit.

item.title: [infoq] 从“单目感知”到“多视角立体对齐”：PrismAlign 重新定义文档结构化提取的精度上限
item.description: PrismAlign, a Huawei paper accepted to EMNLP Industry Track 2026, runs several VLM views over the same document layout and reconciles their outputs with a Bayesian decision layer to curb table-OCR hallucinations. It targets systematic failures such as invented cells, flattened multi-level headers and misread punctuation in nested, rotated or gridline-free tables, and is aimed at teams building document extraction pipelines.

item.title: [infoq] 人人都在造世界模型，HappyWorld‑Bench 试着给出一张统一考卷
item.description: Released at the Yunqi conference, HappyWorld-Bench proposes a shared exam for world models rather than debating definitions, splitting capability into representation, prediction and interaction and grading models across six levels, W1 to W6. It targets a field where Genie 3-style video world generators, 3D reconstruction efforts like Marble and embodied models each set their own rules and claim the lead.

Developers embedding spreadsheet or document features into their own products are the intended users.
